title: Export and reconcile the original Multisim netlist
body: Open DSSS_MAbuain.ms14 in Multisim 14, export the netlist and BOM, capture labelled waveforms, and reconcile comparator and logic-family differences with QEX and the report.

title: Complete electrical schematic before PCB layout
body: Use hardware/audit/pcb-review.md. Resolve logic thresholds, clock-switch timing, reset, demodulator bias, unused pins and test points. Require ERC before routing.

title: Add off-grid CFO acquisition and timing tracking
body: Extend the grid acquisition with a justified estimator and loop. Test acquisition detection/false alarm and residual offset across an explicit operating range.
